description: Cross-language benchmark registry of chaotic/neural dynamical systems. Each entry: family, equations (human-readable), params, initial state, and reference invariants with per-invariant absolute/relative tolerances and literature sources. null refs = pending literature source; orbit-reproducibility only.

entries.name: logistic

lyap1.source: Analytic: for r=4 the logistic map has lambda = ln(2) exactly (standard result; e.g. Ott, Chaos in Dynamical Systems, CUP).

entries.notes: Primary cross-language check: first n_orbit iterates from x0 at 1e-12.

entries.name: henon

lyap1.source: Widely cited value for a=1.4, b=0.3 (e.g. Grassberger-Procaccia analyses; Benettin et al. algorithm family). Method-dependent at the 1e-2 level.

entries.notes: corr_dim ~1.22 often quoted but estimator-dependent; omitted until a protocol is fixed (Grassberger-Procaccia with specified embedding).

entries.name: clifford
entries.equations: x_{n+1} = sin(a*y_n) + c*cos(a*x_n); y_{n+1} = sin(b*x_n) + d*cos(b*y_n)
entries.notes: lambda1 pending a citable source for this parameter set; orbit reproducibility only.

entries.name: tinkerbell
entries.notes: lambda1 pending a citable source for this parameter set; orbit reproducibility only.

entries.name: sierpinski
entries.equations: Chaos game on the 3 vertices of the triangle; w_i(p) = v_i/2 (contraction 1/2), equal probability.

dim.source: Exact: Hausdorff and box dimension of the Sierpinski triangle = log(3)/log(2).

entries.name: barnsley_fern
entries.equations: Barnsley fern: 8 affine maps with classic probabilities (Barnsley, Fractals Everywhere).

dim.source: Literature box-counting estimates cluster near 1.85 (range ~1.84-1.86); method- and resolution-dependent.

entries.notes: Chaos game n=2e5, box sizes eps in [0.05, 0.4] (finer eps saturates: N_boxes approaches n_points). Run-to-run slope spread ~1.78-1.83; rel_tol 0.05 covers that honest method spread.

entries.name: lorenz
entries.equations: dx/dt = sigma*(y - x); dy/dt = x*(rho - z) - y; dz/dt = x*y - beta*z

lyap1.source: Eckhardt & Balsley, Phys. Rev. E 78, 016208 (2008): lambda1 = 0.9056 for sigma=10, rho=28, beta=8/3 (high-precision reference).

entries.name: rossler
entries.equations: dx/dt = -y - z; dy/dt = x + a*y; dz/dt = b + z*(x - c)

lyap1.source: Commonly cited value for a=b=0.2, c=5.7 across chaos texts and tool comparisons; method-dependent at the ~0.005 level. Reported as abs_tol to avoid false precision on a small exponent.

entries.name: thomas
entries.equations: dx/dt = sin(y) - b*x; dy/dt = sin(z) - b*y; dz/dt = sin(x) - b*z
entries.notes: Thomas attractor is chaotic for b near 0.208186 (Sprott attractor catalogue); lambda1 pending a citable numerical source; trajectory + divergence diagnostics only.

entries.name: aizawa
entries.equations: dx/dt = (z - b)*x - d*y; dy/dt = d*x + (z - b)*y; dz/dt = c + a*z - z^3/3 - (x^2 + y^2)*(1 + e*z) + f*z*x^3
entries.notes: Aizawa attractor, standard parameters a=0.95 b=0.7 c=0.6 d=3.5 e=0.25 f=0.1 (widely reproduced); lambda1 observed-only pending a citable high-precision numerical source.

entries.name: hopfield_4
entries.equations: Continuous-time Hopfield net: dx/dt = -x + W*tanh(x); stored patterns must be fixed points of sign(W p) (Hebbian W with zero diagonal, patterns bipolar).

fixed_points.check: sign(W * p) == p for each stored pattern p (zero diagonal, W = (1/n) * sum p p^T with diag zeroed)
fixed_points.source: Analytic property of Hebbian Hopfield weights with zero diagonal for stored bipolar patterns.
